beats.text: In Syria, 11.4% of females are in their early twenties. In Belarus, 4.3%.
East Timor follows right behind at 10.6% of females in that age group.
On the low end, China has 5.2%, and Japan sits at 4.7%.
Eastern Europe drops lower: Latvia has 4.4%, Poland 4.4%, and Belarus 4.3%.
India sits higher at 8.7%, with 2 times the share of Belarus.
